name: Absorption
text: You may play this spell after a unit or Phoenixborn you control is dealt damage. Lower up to 2 non-basic dice in your active pool one level. For each die, prevent 1 damage from being received.

name: Cerulean Diver
text: Dive 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, draw 1 card from the bottom of your draw pile.

name: Full Moon
text:
[[side]] - [[exhaust]]: Choose a unit you control. Add 1 to its attack value for the remainder of the turn.

Focus 1: Choose up to two units you control instead.

Focus 2: Choose up to three units you control instead.

name: Metamorpher
text: Morph: At the start of your turn, you may discard this unit. If you do, place a [[Sun Scarab]] or [[Moon Moth]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Moon Moth
text: Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

name: Moon's Blessing
text: When attaching this spell, search your discard pile for a ready spell and place it into your hand.

name: Reverberate
text: Deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls. Repeat this effect for each other copy of this spell in your discard pile. Then, draw 1 card.

name: River Colossus
text:
Gigantic 1: This unit cannot be blocked or guarded against by units with a life value of 1 or less.

Rouse 2: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may lower 2 non-basic dice in your active pool one level. If you do, add 2 to this unit's attack value for the remainder of the turn.

name: Sandstorm Sage
text: Deep Focus: Ready Spells you control are focused one additional time.

name: Summon Cerulean Diver
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[sympathy:class]]: Place a [[Cerulean Diver]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 1: If you spent any [[sympathy:power]] to activate this spell, you may deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls.

name: Summon Metamorpher
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place a [[Metamorpher]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 1: Draw 1 card.

Focus 2: Then, you may discard 1 card from your hand to search your discard pile for a spell and place it on the bottom of your draw pile.

name: Summon River Colossus
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 2 [[sympathy:class]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place a [[River Colossus]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 2: Then, you may change 4 dice in your active pool to a side of your choice.

name: Sun Scarab
text: Stalk: This unit cannot be guarded against

name: Surging Tempest
text:
[[side]] - [[exhaust]]: Draw 1 card. Raise 2 dice in your active pool one level.

Focus 1: You may discard 1 card from your hand to deal 1 damage to a target unit.

Focus 2: Then, you may discard 1 card from your hand to deal 1 damage to a target Phoenixborn.

name: Transmogrify
text: Choose an alteration spell attached to a target unit. Attach it to another unit controlled by the same player.

name: Twilight Alchemist
text: Alchemize: When this unit comes into play, you may place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your draw pile. If you do, draw 2 cards and raise 2 dice in your active pool one level.

name: Undaunted
text: When attaching this spell, remove 1 exhaustion token from the attached unit.

name: Weight of the World
text: Move 1 exhaustion token from your Phoenixborn to a target unit an opponent controls.
